audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup is built around 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', an ability Hwei does not have. It appears in focus.text, winCon, loading, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[3], report[5] and report[9]. spikes[0].text also names 'Severed Sanity', which is not in the kit.
audit.why: His crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, containing Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The damage palette is Subject: Disaster (Q), 10/9/8/7/6, containing Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt and Molten Fissure. 'Severed Sanity' is a corruption of Severing Bolt.
audit.corrected: Subject: Torment is the CC palette to track; Severing Bolt is the Q-palette bolt.

audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 at 49.47% over 843 games fits: he out-ranges you until level 3 and his palettes cost 80-120 mana, so the lane swings to you once you can survive to Tear and level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side rows read 'Skill' while content win[N] and the packet read Hwei, Hwei, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia.
audit.why: Rows 0 and 1 belong to Hwei — Subject: Disaster out-ranges your 850 Q and he has nothing to fear at level 2, since Miasma's grounding does nothing to a champion with no dash. Rows 3-6 are yours once your fangs and R arrive.
audit.corrected: Six sides realigned (row 2 already agrees), with phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten in the same proposal to match their new verdicts.

audit.why: Subject: Torment 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Subject: Disaster 10/9/8/7/6, Subject: Serenity 18/17.5/17/16.5/16, Spiraling Despair 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). tradeBad and breakdown.trading also warned about 'the dash you were saving W for' — Hwei has no dash.
audit.why: Bodies must match titles, and the bad-trade warning must describe a real risk in this matchup: walking into the Torment paint that completes his signature.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Twin Fang's 40 mana cost and Signature of the Visionary's two-spell detonation.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Land Q before spending E — unpoisoned fangs lose the mana war. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Hwei wins by catching you with Subject: Torment, painting Disaster on top, and detonating his signature as you close.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Petrifying Gaze like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment: 12s at rank 1, 10s maxed — every piece of his crowd control lives on that palette, so dodging it means the burst never chains. - Subject: Disaster is 10s. - Subject: Serenity shields on 18s: force it out first. - Spiraling Despair is 120s.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through grounded peel.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment doubly and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through poison zoning.

edits.after: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or walking into the Torment paint that completes his signature detonation.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Hwei is executable. Bad trade: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Hwei is executable. Bad trade: spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or walking into the Torment paint that completes his signature.

edits.before: All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Every piece of his crowd control is on Subject: Torment, 12s at rank 1 — dodge that paint and nothing else in his kit sticks.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Hwei is executable.
edits.after: Noxious Blast first: Twin Fang costs 40 mana and only pays off on a poisoned target, so lead with Q and fang while it ticks.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Miasma slows for its full duration and Hwei owns no dash to leave it.

edits.before: That’s Hwei’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Standing at 850 range trades your fangs for a free Disaster paint.

edits.before: Your miasma is the anti-dive — spending it on poke means the next engage arrives ungrounded and you have no boots to run.
edits.after: Disaster at 10 seconds into Torment at 12 is his whole kill pattern — step up only once one of the two is spent.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Unpoisoned Twin Fang is 40 mana for chip damage; land Noxious Blast first or you run dry before his palettes return.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by closing distance: his palettes cost 80-120 mana each, so a Hwei who misses one cannot afford to trade with you.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment: every piece of his crowd control lives on that palette, 12s at rank 1 — dodge it and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your Seraph's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s 12-second cooldown, on your Seraph's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: Hwei's Devastating Fire and Severed Sanity combos hit harder and from further away than anything you have this early, forcing you to play defensively and eat CS losses.
edits.after: Hwei's Devastating Fire and Severing Bolt combos hit harder and from further away than anything you have this early, forcing you to play defensively and eat CS losses.

notes: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is fabricated — Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E). It was the matchup's focus ability, so it had spread to focus.text, winCon, loading, enemyWin, cooldowns, feeding, a Do's bullet and three report entries. Replaced everywhere except report[3].t, which still reads 'Great trade: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' and needs the same swap — left only to stay inside the two-report-rewrite limit. spikes[0].text's 'Severed Sanity' was a corruption of Severing Bolt and is fixed. Chart: six sides realigned to the content layer and packet, with the two whys that would have contradicted their new verdict rewritten alongside; no paired win[N] edits exist because win[0..6] already match the packet.
